name: Galvika
desc:
One of the previous Acolytes of the [Lullaby Isles](location:lullaby_isles).

In the Strange Missives he wrote to [The Hive](faction:the_hive) about a festivity of [the Faith](faction:the_moonlit_faith), known as the "Nostri Eclipse". He urged [the Hive](faction:the_hive) to stay away from their territories, or else "<the all-too-familiar matercrypt will receive those who do not heed this warning into its sunk'n shores".
additional_info: -   Currently, the first known Acolyte, with the second being Thal'assis Linnaes.
